messages:
Mia Chen: Quick design review from the dashboard pass  split-button (primary + caret) hover state in dark mode has low contrast on hover; also the compact table headers look visually cramped when this control sits inside them. Screenshot in staging.
Sam Patel: I can repro on chrome/mac. The hover uses `color.primary-600` on dark bg and fails WCAG AA. Which token controls that?
Lucía Rivera: Hover color comes from `color.interactive-hover` which we recently adjusted for light mode only. There's no dark-mode variant like `color.interactive-hover-dark`.
Nora Li: For the table header spacing, we used `spacing.table-compact-1` for padding but the split button is 40px wide and the header cell only has 8px left/right, so the visual feels cramped.
Arjun Iyer: CSS snippets: ```css
.split-btn { background: var(--color-surface); color: var(--color-interactive); }
.split-btn:hover { background: var(--color-surface-hover); color: var(--color-interactive-hover); }
.table-header.compact th { padding: var(--spacing-table-compact-1); }
```
Sam Patel: Proposal: 1) add `--color-interactive-hover-dark` with higher contrast; 2) introduce `--spacing-table-compact-2` as a mid token so header cells can breathe when controls are present; 3) update split-button to reference a `--control-padding-inline` token so buttons inside headers get consistent padding.
design-bot: lint: missing tokens detected: "color.interactive-hover-dark" and "spacing.table-compact-2". Recommend adding tokens and referencing them in components (lint-id: token-missing-19499).
Mia Chen: Accessibility nit: when split-button expands, aria-expanded toggles but there's no visible focus on the caret on keyboard nav. We should ensure the caret is a separate focus target or include the whole control in the tab order with clear visual outline.
Lucía Rivera: Agree. My preference is make the whole split control a single composite button for keyboard with internal focus ring when arrow pressed; but we must provide visible focus for the caret when it's tabbable. Add `outline-offset: 3px` and avoid clipping via overflow.
Nora Li: UX tradeoff: single composite button simplifies keyboard but reduces discoverability of the menu. We can keep two tabbable elements but ensure caret has aria-label and visible focus. Linter should enforce `aria-label` for caret-only buttons.
Sam Patel: I'll add `--color-interactive-hover-dark: #9bd4ff` (example) and add `--spacing-table-compact-2: 12px` to tokens.yml. Also add `--control-padding-inline: 8px` and update split-button styles: ```css
.split-btn { padding: 6px var(--control-padding-inline); }
.table-header.compact th { padding-left: var(--spacing-table-compact-2); padding-right: var(--spacing-table-compact-2); }
.split-btn:hover { color: var(--color-interactive-hover-dark); }
```
Arjun Iyer: I'll take the keyboard focus behavior. Plan: 1) ensure caret has `aria-label="Open menu"` and `role="button"` if tabbable; 2) add focus-visible styles with outline and offset; 3) add a11y tests to verify the composite vs split behavior across NVDA/VO.
design-bot: automated check queued: will re-run once tokens are added and PRs open. (lint-id: token-add-wait-19499)
Nora Li: Docs note: update split-button pattern docs to show both patterns (composite + split) with recommended use cases and keyboard interaction examples. Also include a note about header density: prefer `spacing.table-compact-2` when placing controls inside headers.
Mia Chen: Can we also check visual diffs for narrow widths? The split button in a tight header can push the column label. If we increase padding we should test truncation and tooltip behavior.
Sam Patel: Will open PR for tokens + CSS changes. I'll include staging link and visual diffs for 1280/1024/375 widths.
Arjun Iyer: I'll open a small PR for keyboard and ARIA fixes and link it to Sam's branch so we can review together. I'll add NVDA+VO test notes.
Sam Patel: PR opened: tokens + split-button updates + staging link in PR description. Visual diffs included.
Arjun Iyer: PR opened for a11y fixes and keyboard examples; linked to Sam's branch. Added test steps for QA.
Lucía Rivera: Reviewed both PRs, left one comment about hover color ramp in tokens (suggest slightly darker for low-vision).
Mia Chen: Spot-checked staging at multiple widths and on dark-mode. Hover contrast improved, header spacing feels better with `spacing.table-compact-2`. Keyboard focus for caret visible and aria-label reads correctly.
design-bot: re-lint: tokens present and aria-label checks passed for split-button caret. No blocking issues. (lint-id: token-validate-19499)
Sam Patel: Merged tokens + styling PR after address comments.
Arjun Iyer: Merged a11y PR after QA.
Mia Chen: Thanks all. Closing thread  please follow up in the component docs update issue for split-button patterns.
